## Purpose and entry points
Sure is a self-hostable personal-finance and wealth-management platform. The primary runtime is a Ruby on Rails application served by Puma, with HTML/Turbo/Stimulus browser UI and a versioned JSON API used by mobile, API clients, and agents. Start locally with `bin/dev`; request routing begins at `config/routes.rb`, application boot at `config/application.rb`, and web/API controllers under `app/controllers/`.

## Tenancy, identity, and access boundary
`Family` is the financial-data tenant, with users, settings, connected providers, and financial records scoped beneath it. Authentication supports sessions, password flows, MFA/passkeys, OAuth/OIDC/SSO, API keys, and mobile OAuth. Controllers centralize application authentication and resource authorization, while policies enforce key domain access.
Paths: `app/models/family.rb`, `app/models/user.rb`, `app/controllers/application_controller.rb`, `app/policies/family_policy.rb`, `app/controllers/api/v1/base_controller.rb`.

## Financial ledger and portfolio core
Accounts unify manual and provider-backed assets/liabilities. Entries and entryable transaction/trade records form the operational ledger; balances, holdings, securities, valuations, transfers, categories, merchants, and tags enrich it. Balance and holding materializers/calculators derive historical/current portfolio state rather than exposing only raw imported data.
Paths: `app/models/account.rb`, `app/models/entry.rb`, `app/models/transaction.rb`, `app/models/balance/materializer.rb`, `app/models/holding/materializer.rb`.

## Provider ingestion and synchronization
Financial institutions, exchanges, brokers, and wallets are isolated behind provider SDK/adapters. Provider-specific `Item` objects coordinate fetch/import lifecycle; provider-account processors normalize remote payloads into common accounts, entries, holdings, and securities. Family/account syncers and `Sync` records coordinate execution and state; webhook endpoints handle inbound provider events.
Paths: `app/models/provider/registry.rb`, `app/models/plaid_item/importer.rb`, `app/models/simplefin_item/syncer.rb`, `app/models/account/provider_import_adapter.rb`, `app/jobs/sync_job.rb`, `app/controllers/webhooks_controller.rb`.

## Import, normalization, and automation pipeline
Users can import files and account statements through staged upload, preflight, mapping, confirmation, and asynchronous processing. Imported transactions then feed merchant detection, categorization, transfer matching, recurring-series identification, and rules. Rules separate conditions from executable actions and run asynchronously for broad application.
Paths: `app/models/import.rb`, `app/models/import/preflight.rb`, `app/jobs/import_job.rb`, `app/models/rule/action_executor.rb`, `app/models/recurring_transaction/pipeline.rb`, `app/jobs/apply_all_rules_job.rb`.

## Finance products and analytical projections
The normalized ledger feeds budgets, bills/recurrences, goals, cash-flow and income statements, net-worth balance sheets, reports, and generated insights. These are domain calculations and projections over family-scoped accounts and transactions, rendered in dashboard/report surfaces and exposed by API.
Paths: `app/models/budget.rb`, `app/models/goal.rb`, `app/models/income_statement.rb`, `app/models/balance_sheet.rb`, `app/models/insight/generator.rb`, `app/controllers/api/v1/balance_sheet_controller.rb`.

## AI, client surfaces, and operations
Chats invoke configurable built-in or external assistants, function tools, LLM providers (OpenAI/Anthropic), usage tracking, and optional vector stores. The Rails UI uses ViewComponents, Tailwind, Importmap, Stimulus, Turbo, and Action Cable. Native clients are a Flutter mobile app and Tauri desktop shell, both consuming the Rails API. Sidekiq workers require Redis; PostgreSQL is primary persistence. Helm manifests deploy separate web/worker workloads, Redis, and CloudNativePG; integrations include Plaid, Stripe, APNs, market-data services, Langfuse, Sentry, PostHog, and Skylight.
Paths: `app/models/assistant/responder.rb`, `app/models/vector_store/registry.rb`, `mobile/lib/main.dart`, `desktop/src-tauri/src/main.rs`, `config/sidekiq.yml`, `charts/sure/templates/web-deployment.yaml`.
